当开发者需要构建HarmonyOS应用程序时，Ability Kit是必不可少的框架
无论你是开发简单的单页面应用还是复杂的多组件协作应用，都需要通过Ability Kit定义应用模型、管理组件生命周期和配置应用权限
如果你需要实现UIAbility组件的开发、页面间导航或应用间跳转，应使用Ability Kit提供的Stage模型和Want机制
当开发者需要实现跨应用协作或拉起指定类型应用时，应使用Ability Kit的意图框架和应用链接能力
例如需要拉起金融类、邮件类、航班类、快递类、导航类或图片编辑类应用时，可以通过startAbilityByType接口实现
如果你需要实现Deep Linking或App Linking跳转，或者需要通过意图框架接入标准意图，Ability Kit提供了完整的开发指导

接入 App Linking 从浏览器或其他应用唤起应用 / Integrate app linking to launch the app from a browser or another app
实现跨应用跳转并传递业务数据 / Implement cross-app navigation and pass business data

preconditions: 工程已启用与目标范式匹配的应用模型与配置文件（Stage使用app.json5/module.json5，FA使用config.json） / The project has enabled the application model and configuration files matching the target paradigm (Stage uses app.json5/module.json5, FA uses config.json)

待启动或被拉起的Ability/Extension已在配置文件中正确定义，包含必要的名称、类型、导出属性和skills/uri配置 / The target Ability/Extension to launch or expose is correctly declared in configuration, including required name, type, export attributes, and skills/uri settings

若涉及跨应用跳转、Deep Linking或受保护组件访问，调用方与被调方所需权限及可见性声明已完成配置 / If cross-app launch, Deep Linking, or protected component access is involved, required permissions and visibility declarations for caller and callee are configured
若涉及运行时权限申请，相关权限已在配置中声明且用户授权流程可被触发 / If runtime permission requests are involved, the relevant permissions are declared in config and the user-grant flow can be triggered

postconditions.statement: 已新增或修改Ability相关配置，使目标UIAbility/ServiceAbility/DataAbility/Extension可被系统识别 / Ability-related configuration has been added or updated so the target UIAbility/ServiceAbility/DataAbility/Extension can be recognized by the system
postconditions.judge_prompt: Does the edit set add or modify HarmonyOS app configuration files to declare an Ability or Extension component with recognizable metadata such as name, type, or skills?

postconditions.statement: 已实现或更新基于Want的启动、跳转或参数传递代码 / Want-based launch, navigation, or parameter-passing code has been implemented or updated
postconditions.judge_prompt: Do the edits include code that constructs, passes, or handles a Want (or equivalent launch parameters) for starting an ability or navigating between components/apps?

postconditions.statement: 已补充与场景匹配的生命周期、启动模式或链接处理逻辑 / Lifecycle, launch-mode, or link-handling logic appropriate to the scenario has been added
postconditions.judge_prompt: Do the changes add or update lifecycle callbacks, launch mode settings, or deep/app link handling related to Ability Kit usage?
